problem.title: Healthcare shouldn't be lost in translation.
problem.subtitle: But for millions of newcomers in Germany, it is — at the exact moment they need to be understood the most.
problem.card_1_body: When you finally sit across from a doctor, the words you need most are the ones you don't have. Symptoms get misdescribed. Diagnoses get blurred.
problem.card_2_body: Your medical history lives in a clinic two countries away — in a language no one here reads. Half of every appointment gets spent on misunderstandings. You leave with a prescription you can't read.

solution.title: Three things BioTrail does, so you don't have to.
solution.subtitle: One wallet for your medical life. Built for the way you actually use it — in clinics, in emergencies, on your phone.
solution.step_1_body: Upload existing documents — prescriptions, vaccination cards, lab results, surgery notes. BioTrail translates, structures, and stores them in a single wallet that lives on your phone.
solution.step_2_body: Real-time translation during your appointment — voice, text, and documents. Show the doctor what you mean. Hear what they actually said. No more 'I think she said something about my heart.'

pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.

about.title: Built by four founders who've each crossed a border.
about.body: BioTrail is a project of four students at Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, born out of the Lean Startup Bootcamp 2026. We've all moved countries. We've all stared at a prescription we couldn't read. We're building the answer we wish we'd had.
